---
title: "Brazilian Peppertree Biological Control Mapping"
subtitle: "RStudio mapping, ecological monitoring, and invasive species data visualization"
---

## Overview

This project used RStudio and spatial data workflows to visualize biological control agent releases, damage sightings, and establishment patterns for Brazilian peppertree biological control efforts across Florida.

## Research Goal

The goal was to translate field monitoring records into clear spatial products that could support program tracking, ecological interpretation, and conservation communication.

## Tools Used

-   RStudio
-   R
-   tidyverse
-   ggplot2
-   sf
-   ArcGIS Pro
-   Excel
-   Ecological monitoring records

## Methods

-   Cleaned and organized field monitoring records
-   Prepared spatial data for mapping
-   Visualized biological control release locations
-   Mapped damage sightings and establishment observations
-   Created outputs for program communication and outreach
